shots.focal_element: Small gradient rounded-square tile inside a rotating glowing outline square, centred in a dark radial vignette
shots.transition_other: opening shot; no incoming transition (video starts on the abstract tile)
on_screen_text: Building modern apps requires dynamic tech stacks,
shots.typography: Clean humanist sans (low-confidence guess: IBM Plex Sans), semibold, sentence case, normal tracking, two centred lines; words blur in one by one in sync with the voice-over (w0-w6)
shots.what_happens: Opens on a gradient tile wrapped by a thin glowing square outline that rotates; the headline resolves word by word from heavy blur to sharp while a larger outline square grows and tilts around the tile as the camera begins to push in.
shots.build_rebuild: Centre a 120px gradient rounded square with a rotating 2px glowing outline square behind it on a radial dark-purple gradient, and reveal each headline word with a staggered blur(12px)->blur(0) + opacity fade timed to the VO word starts.

shots.focal_element: Nested concentric rotated squares and a large translucent rounded-square plate framing the centred headline
shots.transition_other: continuous camera push into the nested shapes (zoom-like), headline stays locked on screen
on_screen_text: Building modern apps requires dynamic tech stacks,
shots.typography: Same semibold humanist sans, sentence case, white, fully sharp now; two centred lines locked to screen while geometry moves behind
shots.what_happens: The camera keeps pushing through layers of rotated outline squares and a frosted rounded-square plate; the shapes counter-rotate and scale past the lens while the headline holds steady in front.
shots.build_rebuild: Stack 4-5 rotated outline squares and one translucent rounded-rect plate at increasing scales, animate scale up (about 1.0->2.5) with opposing rotations over ~0.7s, keeping the text layer static above them.

shots.focal_element: Centred headline swapping from 'Building modern apps...' to 'which become increasingly hard to monitor' over a fan of 3D glassy panels
shots.transition_other: continuation of the geometric zoom; shapes fly past then the scene blur-dissolves into the 3D panel fan
on_screen_text: Building modern apps requires dynamic tech stacks,
which become increasingly hard to monitor
shots.typography: Semibold humanist sans, sentence case, white, two centred lines; outgoing line blurs out, incoming line blurs in word by word (w7-w12)
shots.what_happens: Outline squares rotate and scatter outward while the first sentence blurs away; a curved row of tall translucent violet-blue glass panels appears in perspective and drifts, and the second sentence resolves word by word from blur.
shots.build_rebuild: Crossfade the geometric layer into a row of 10-12 tall gradient glass planes arranged on a curved 3D arc (rotateY staggered), slowly orbiting, while the new line reveals with a per-word blur-to-sharp stagger matched to VO.

shots.focal_element: Two-tier brand lockup 'Datadog's / ecosystem' on a soft purple glow field
shots.transition_other: blur dissolve: panels and 'hard to monitor' text blur out and the glow field with new title blurs in
on_screen_text: which become increasingly hard to monitor
shots.typography: Two-tier hierarchy: small semibold 'Datadog's' above large bold 'ecosystem', lowercase/sentence case, tight tracking; same humanist sans; appears with blur-in and ends softly blurred
shots.what_happens: The glass-panel fan blurs and fades away with its sentence; a diffuse purple-blue aurora gradient fills the frame and the 'Datadog's ecosystem' title sharpens in the centre, then softens again as it hands off.
shots.build_rebuild: Blur the previous scene to ~20px while fading out, fade in an animated multi-stop radial aurora gradient, and blur-in a two-size stacked title (small label 40px over 96px bold word) centred.

shots.focal_element: Huge '700+' stat over a full-bleed isometric wall of integration logo tiles
shots.transition_other: light-sweep wipe: a purple glow passes from the left as the isometric logo wall replaces the aurora field
shots.typography: Very large heavy/bold '700+' numeral over a smaller semibold two-line label in title case; the label first reads 'Integrations' then extends to 'Integrations and Marketplace offerings' in sync with w18-w21; white, centred
shots.what_happens: A diagonal isometric grid of dark tiles bearing third-party technology logos fills the frame and drifts slowly; '700+' sits large in the centre and the subline grows from 'Integrations' to 'Integrations and Marketplace offerings' as the VO says it.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a skewed isometric CSS grid of ~200 dark rounded logo tiles slowly translating diagonally, darken the centre with a radial vignette, and overlay a 200px bold '700+' with a subline whose second phrase fades in on the VO word.

shots.focal_element: Two-tier headline 'See inside / any source' over the drifting isometric logo wall
shots.transition_other: text swap on a continuous background: the logo wall keeps drifting while the stat text is replaced by the new headline
shots.typography: Two-tier: medium semibold 'See inside' over a larger bold 'any source', sentence/lower case, tight tracking, white, centred
shots.what_happens: The isometric logo wall continues its slow diagonal drift and slight push-in while the centred headline 'See inside any source' replaces the 700+ stat, echoing the VO (w25-w28).
shots.build_rebuild: Keep the isometric logo grid layer running from the previous shot and swap the centre text group to a stacked two-size headline with a quick fade/blur-in timed to the VO word 'see'.
